request.text: Aik student ne 10 minute par do colored items ko dekhte hue kaha 'upar 5 aayega'. Phir, kareeb 12 minute par, usi tarah ke test mein jab aap ne 'kyun?' pucha, to ek student ne sahi jawab '3,7' diya lekin woh sirf numbers repeat karne laga. In do alag waqt par, aap ke nazdeek, unke sochne ka tareeka kya badal gaya tha?
